purpose: PUBLIC measured datasets that constrain the model in inputs/Q146_model.py (Q146 nasal route with swallowed and systemic fractions)
scope_rule: Only sources whose URL returned HTTP 200 (or whose metadata was checked against the provider's own API) in this run. No numbers are invented; every field marked UNKNOWN is deliberately unknown.

sources.title: NHANES 2017-March 2020: Cotinine and Hydroxycotinine - Serum (P_COT)
sources.publisher: CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (USA)
sources.license: US public domain (federal government work, no copyright)
sources.license_verified: stated by CDC/NCHS as public domain; no paywall, no registration for download
sources.size_verified: yes - Content-Length from HTTP HEAD/GET 200, matches bytes on disk
sources.subjects: 13027 NHANES 2017-March 2020 examined participants with a serum result; 11395 with quantified cotinine; of these 3365 with cotinine >= 0.3 ng/mL (DHHS exposure cutpoint)
sources.units: LBXCOT = Cotinine, Serum (ng/mL); LBXHCOT = Hydroxycotinine, Serum (ng/mL); assay = ID-HPLC-APCI-MS/MS
sources.coordinate_frame: NONE spatial - cross-sectional bioanalytical cohort, no voxel array, no time axis. Index frame = participant (SEQN) x analyte; acquisition frame = NHANES MEC morning examination, fasting venous serum

output_or_parameter: E_H hepatic leg / CYP2A6 activity spread
constrains.why: measures the NICOTINE METABOLITE RATIO NM = hydroxycotinine/cotinine, a CYP2A6 activity index, and the population spread of cotinine. It is a steady-state exposure snapshot, not a mass balance, so it cannot identify an extraction ratio or a mucosal metabolism fraction.

sources.title: Nicotrol NS (nicotine nasal spray) 10 mg/mL - FDA approved labelling, NDA 020385/S-011
sources.publisher: US Food and Drug Administration (Center for Drug Evaluation and Research)
sources.size_verified: yes - HTTP 200, application/pdf, 970507 bytes on disk
sources.format: PDF (text layer is font-subset encoded; NOT machine-extractable locally)
sources.subjects: n = 30 (mean with 5th/95th percentile curves, 1 mg single nasal dose); n = 16 in the repeated-dose Tmax table of the S-010 label
sources.units: plasma nicotine ng/mL; times in minutes; doses in mg

measured_values_reported.rhinitis_effect: Cmax reduced ~20% (1.5 ng/mL), tmax prolonged ~30% (7 min)

sources.values_provenance: read from the search-engine text extraction of the label URL above and independently from the DailyMed mirror of the same label; the PDF text layer itself is subset-encoded and could not be extracted locally

output_or_parameter: output F_abs for a metered nasal spray
constrains.why: same route and same dose as the model (1 mg metered nasal spray): an independent public absolute-bioavailability measurement (0.53) alongside the R1 value (0.58) the model was fitted to, plus the measured time-to-peak that the model gets wrong by 5-19x

sources.reason_not_sampled: kept as the >1 numerical anchor; the prereg froze ONE sample (D1) for the machine-read proof of loading

sources.title: MRTP study report SM WS 02 - open-label cross-over, four snus types vs Nicorette 2 mg gum, per-subject plasma nicotine AUC
sources.publisher: US Food and Drug Administration, Tobacco Products Office (MRTP public docket)
sources.size_verified: yes - HTTP 200, application/pdf, 373589 bytes on disk
sources.format: PDF clinical study report; contains a per-subject tabulation 'AUC (h*ng/mL)' with one column per product (Catch Lic 1g, Catch Mini, Dry Mini, Nicorette) - locally verified present by text extraction
sources.subjects: per-subject rows in the AUC table (sequence verified: subject 1 = 46.82 / 45.26 / 37.22 / 24.57 / 16.56 h*ng/mL); exact n not extracted (UNKNOWN)
sources.units: AUC h*ng/mL; Cmax ng/mL; dosing interval 10-12 h

output_or_parameter: Params.k_gi_h and F_oral (the GI leg fed by the swallowed fraction)
REGIONS[*].chi_swallow - buccal/gum formulations with a known swallowed share
constrains.strength: strong for the GI leg, indirect for chi_swallow
constrains.why: per-subject plasma exposure for an oral/buccal product in a real cohort, i.e. the only public route-resolved nicotine PK table found; the buccal gum arm is the closest public analogue to the model's swallowed leg, but the report does NOT resolve how much of the dose was swallowed vs buccally absorbed

sources.title: NasalSeg: a dataset for automatic segmentation of nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses from 3D CT images
sources.publisher: Zenodo (Zhang Y., Wang J., Pan T., Jiang Q., Ge J.)
sources.license_verified: yes - from the Zenodo records API (metadata.license.id = cc-by-4.0)
sources.size_verified: yes - Zenodo API, single file NasalSeg.zip, checksum md5:ba83df47974d9077...
sources.format: zip of CT volumes + NIfTI-style label maps, 5 structures (right/left nasal cavity, nasal pharynx, right/left maxillary sinus)
sources.coordinate_frame: patient image frame (DICOM LPS; NIfTI affine in RAS) per scan

constrains.strength: strong in principle (n = 130 subjects, per-region masks)
constrains.why: the only open, per-subject, region-resolved human nasal CT segmentation found; directly measurable surface area per region, which is exactly the model's assumed 10/15/50/80/10 cm2 block
constrains.caveats: segmentation-based surface area is an upper bound on true mucosal area (cartilage, bone, and lining are lumped); sinonasal pathology is present in a clinical sample

sources.reason_not_sampled: 224 MB > 50 MB cap frozen in PREREG C7 - not downloaded

sources.title: Airflow in the human nasal passage and sinuses of chronic rhinosinusitis subjects (CT-derived nasal/sinus CFD meshes + pressure data)
sources.publisher: Dryad (Kumar H., Jain R., Douglas R.G., Tawhai M.H.); Zenodo mirror
sources.license_verified: yes - Zenodo records API, metadata.license.id = cc-zero
sources.size_verified: yes - Zenodo API, 6 files: 4x .cfx5 meshes (337-532 MB each) + 2 small .dat pressure files
sources.format: ANSYS CFX meshes (.cfx5) from CT; ASCII pressure/flow tables (.dat)
sources.subjects: 4 human subjects (normal + chronic rhinosinusitis, pre- and postoperative)
sources.units: mesh in mm (CT); .dat in Pa and L/s
sources.coordinate_frame: patient CT image frame per subject

output_or_parameter: REGIONS[*].v_clear_mm_min (via measured pressure-flow, i.e. hydraulic resistance)
constrains.why: measured pressure/flow per subject is a genuine measurement, not CFD output; but n = 4, sinonasal pathology, and no mucosal-surface segmentation
constrains.caveats: meshes are CFD surface meshes of the AIRWAY, not the mucosa

sources.reason_not_sampled: every geometry file is 337-532 MB > 50 MB cap (PREREG C7)
